# Skill dispatch index

One row per skill: the trigger phrases (the developer's own words) and the file that owns the
full skill. For an agent without native skill discovery — GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2022,
or any editor that only reads instruction files — this is the one-hop route: find the matching
row, read that skill file, follow it. Paths are relative to this tree's root (`ssdt-agent/`
when the tree is vendored in the estate repository).

## Operations (the catalog — one per schema change)

- `add-check` — Use when the developer says "Total must be positive", "Status has to be one of these values", "age can't be negative" → `skills/op/add-check/SKILL.md`
- `add-default` — Use when the developer says "give this attribute a default value", "new rows should default to Active", "everything new should start as Pending" → `skills/op/add-default/SKILL.md`
- `add-index` — Use when the developer says "add an index on Customer.Email", "make this attribute searchable", "the list screen is slow, can we index it" → `skills/op/add-index/SKILL.md`

## Capabilities (the working skills the operations compose)

- `ask-the-developer` — Use whenever proving surfaces a decision only a human can make → `skills/ask-the-developer/SKILL.md`
- `author-pr` — Use to turn a proven schema change into the pull request a reviewer approves by reading → `skills/author-pr/SKILL.md`
- `author-review` — Use when the reviewer writes its disposition → `skills/author-review/SKILL.md`
- `classify-mechanism` — Use after confirm-intent has named the operation and gathered the three state-variables, to state PROVISIONALLY how a change ships and who must review it, before proving. Walks the handbook decision cascade (file 15 =… → `skills/classify-mechanism/SKILL.md`
- `confirm-intent` — Use FIRST, before any classification or proving, whenever an OutSystems-native developer asks for a schema change in their own words ("make Email required", "rename this attribute", "add a foreign key", "drop that tab… → `skills/confirm-intent/SKILL.md`
- `decompose` — Use FIRST when one request needs several schema changes at once → `skills/decompose/SKILL.md`
- `deploy-scripts` — The deployment-script lifecycle rails. Use whenever a change needs a pre-deployment, post-deployment, or ad-hoc script → `skills/deploy-scripts/SKILL.md`
- `os-vocabulary` — The OutSystems <-> SQL Server vocabulary for the conversation surface. Use at intake and any time the developer's words and the SSDT world need translating in either direction → `skills/os-vocabulary/SKILL.md`
- `prove-on-dacpac` — Use when a data-model change has a provisional classification from classify-mechanism and must be confirmed (or flipped) against real-shaped data. Builds the .sqlproj to a dacpac, previews the real SSDT-generated delt… → `skills/prove-on-dacpac/SKILL.md`
- `talk-to-local-sql` — The disposable local-SQL substrate prove-on-dacpac publishes against, dispatched per machine. Use whenever prove-on-dacpac needs a local SQL Server to publish to, a fresh-or-reset disposable database, ad-hoc sqlcmd pr… → `skills/talk-to-local-sql/SKILL.md`
